summary: Telefonica Brasil filed a Form 6-K reporting the merger of its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Cyberco Brasil into Telefonica Infraestrutura e Seguranca Ltda. (TIS), dissolving Cyberco Brasil. The merger was based on book value, resulted in no change to TIS's share capital or the company's indirect equity interest, and is a routine internal reorganization to simplify structures and capture synergies. No shareholder approval, advisor, or deal terms were disclosed. No special-situation classification applies as the filing describes a standard intra-group restructuring with no external impact on shareholders.
